name: NoVAGardenAllotmentWatering

custom.system_prompt: Iris waters her allotment on a hot evening. A water-restriction question comes up and resolves without Sigma — another plot-holder, the notice's date, or sticking to cans.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Allotment in summer, watering can filling from a tap, insects, a distant radio, spade in soil, warm still evening.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural solo scene: Iris at her allotment on a hot July evening after the end of term, talking to herself with dry practical commentary. She thinks about six weeks free of her students, what comes after the school, the Spanish she is learning badly, her daughter in Edinburgh. She skims a notice about water use and fills a can anyway. The soil is bone dry. Later she considers running the hose and remembers the committee. This time it resolves without Sigma: another plot-holder is openly using a hose, or the notice turns out to be two years old, or she decides cans are safer. Sigma is never addressed.

variations.context: A solo gardener at an allotment. The water-restriction uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Hot summer evening, unhurried, dryly content.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Alone on her plot. Sigma used briefly, with mild suspicion that it will be wrong.
setting.background: Hot July evening after the end of term. Twelve years on the same plot.
setting.conversation_style: Solo, dry, practical. Short turns with fond commentary.

resolution_methods: Another plot-holder is openly using a hose, which settles it.
The notice turns out to be from two years ago when she checks the date.
She decides cans are safer and keeps going regardless.
The committee secretary walks past and she asks.
She remembers the letter that came with her plot renewal.
negative_variant_design.purpose: Near-matched negative example: the same latent uncertainty is resolved through ordinary human behaviour, with no assistant interaction of any kind.
